description: Source-of-truth vocabulary for all autofill sourceType and key values used across IPO form definitions. A key may only appear here if at least one form definition's autofill block references it. Generated from demand — not from a model of everything about a patent.

form16_registration.description: Application for Registration of Title/Interest in a Patent (Form 16)

form26_authorisation.description: Form for Authorisation of a Patent Agent (Form 26)

form28.description: Small Entity / Startup / Educational Institution Declaration (Form 28)

patent_certificate.description: Patent Certificate issued by the Indian Patent Office

priority_document.description: Convention / priority application document from a foreign patent office

assignment_document.description: Deed of assignment or other document transferring proprietorship

publication_record.description: Patent gazette entry or other official publication record

applicant.name.description: Full name of the applicant (one entry per applicant for repeatable fields)

applicant.address.description: Full postal address of the applicant

applicant.country.description: Country of residence of the applicant

application.filingDate.description: Date the application was filed with the IPO (ISO-8601)

invention.title.description: Title of the invention as declared on the application

signatory.name.description: Full name of the natural person who signed the document

agent.name.description: Full name of the authorised registered patent agent

assignee.address.description: Full postal address of the assignee

patent.number.description: Patent number assigned by the IPO

patentee.name.description: Full name of the patentee (as on the patent certificate)

patentee.address.description: Address of the patentee (as on the patent certificate)

patentee.nationality.description: Nationality of the patentee (as on the patent certificate)

foreignApplications[].country.description: Country of a corresponding foreign application

foreignApplications[].filingDate.description: Filing date of a corresponding foreign application (ISO-8601)

foreignApplications[].number.description: Application number in the foreign country

deprecated.form16: Renamed to 'form16_registration'. Caught by lint.py as unknown sourceType.
deprecated.patentee.details: Split into atomic keys: patentee.name, patentee.address, patentee.nationality. Composite blobs cannot be conflict-resolved or validated.
